page.title: Restore
page.description: Recover a whole machine from a restore point.

toast.instantUnreachableDesc: The instant restore was not started. Check the backend and try again.
toast.restoreUnreachableDesc: The restore was not started. Check the backend and try again.

refused.title: The appliance refused the restore
refused.desc: The restore point may have been pruned — pick another point and retry.

started.title: Restore started
started.desc: Recovering {{name}}. Watch it run live in Activity.
started.descFiles_one: Recovering {{count}} file from {{name}}. Watch it run live in Activity.
started.descFiles_other: Recovering {{count}} files from {{name}}. Watch it run live in Activity.

insufficientSpace.title: Not enough datastore space
insufficientSpace.desc: The target datastore doesn't have enough free space for this restore.

originalVmGone.title: The original VM is gone
originalVmGone.desc: It was removed after this wizard loaded, so there's nothing left to restore in place. Start over to restore it as a new VM instead.

chooseVm.title: Which VM would you like to recover?
chooseVm.subtitle: Pick any protected machine. We'll show its restore points next — nothing changes until you confirm.

noMatch.title: No machines match that search
noMatch.desc: Try a different name, OS, IP address or tag.

empty.desc: Run a backup job first — protected VMs with restore points will appear here, ready to recover.

chooseHost.title: Which server would you like to recover?
chooseHost.subtitle: Pick any protected physical server. We'll show its restore points next — nothing changes until you confirm.

noMatch.title: No servers match that search
noMatch.desc: Try a different name, OS, IP address or tag.

empty.desc: Run a server or file backup job first — protected servers with restore points will appear here, ready to recover.

chooseDisk.title: Which disk would you like to recover?
chooseDisk.subtitle: Pick any protected disk — virtual or physical. We'll show its restore points next — nothing changes until you confirm.
chooseDisk.searchPlaceholder: Search by disk, device, VM or server…

noMatch.title: No disks match that search
noMatch.desc: Try a different disk, device, VM or server name.

empty.desc: Run a disk backup job first — protected disks with restore points will appear here, ready to recover.

point.title: Pick a point in time to recover from
point.allUnreachable: None can be selected while their repository is offline.
point.mostRecentSelected: The most recent is selected for you.
point.unreachableCallout_one: <1>{{count}} restore point</1> can't be reached — its repository is offline. The backups still exist, but can't be restored until the repository comes back online.
point.unreachableCallout_other: <1>{{count}} restore points</1> can't be reached — their repository is offline. The backups still exist, but can't be restored until the repository comes back online.
point.blockedCallout_one: <1>{{count}} restore point</1> failed a file health check or is not fully written, so it's visible here but cannot be restored.
point.blockedCallout_other: <1>{{count}} restore points</1> failed a file health check or are not fully written, so they're visible here but cannot be restored.

empty.title: This {{noun}} has no restore points yet
empty.desc: Once a backup job protects this machine, recovery points will line up here on a timeline.

point.encryptedTip: This backup's data is encrypted at rest
point.offlineTip: This restore point's repository is offline — it can't be read until the repository comes back online.

block.corrupt: This restore point failed its backup-file health check and is blocked from restore.
block.checking: A health check is currently reading this restore point.
block.failed: The backup files could not be written completely.
block.pending: Backup files are still being written.

health.metadataUnverifiedTitle: This older manifest has no integrity checksum; its metadata could not be verified.

howToRecover: How would you like to recover?

review.title: Review & confirm
review.subtitle: One last look. Nothing has changed yet.

cleanSource.body: We read the backup without ever touching it, so the source you're recovering from stays intact.

mode.subtitle: Choose whether to bring back the whole machine or just a few files. You'll confirm before anything runs.

entireVm.title: Entire VM
entireVm.desc: Recover the full machine — every disk, exactly as it was at this point.

fileLevel.title: File-level recovery
fileLevel.desc: Browse the snapshot and pull back just the files or folders you need.

instant.title: Instant boot
instant.desc: Power the VM on directly off the backup in seconds — nothing is copied. Blocks stream in on demand; ideal for a quick check or DR failover.

original.title: Original location
original.desc: Restore under the VM's original name, host and datastore. If that VM still exists, it's overwritten in place once the restore finishes writing — you'll confirm before anything runs.

newLocation.title: New location
newLocation.desc: Restore as a copy to another host — safe for testing or side-by-side checks.

mode.instantCallout: The guest boots on its own host straight from the repository over iSCSI — blocks fault in as it reads them, so it's running in seconds with no full copy. Writes land in a scratch overlay, so the backup itself is never touched. Discard it when you're done to release the disk.

sub.instant: Runs off the backup over iSCSI — no copy
sub.original: Same name, host & datastore as the original
sub.newLocation: As a copy to a new location

mode.originalOverwriteWarning: This restores <1>{{name}}</1> in place, at its current host and datastore. Once every disk is fully written, the VM currently running there is destroyed and replaced — this can't be undone.

restoredVmNameError.whitespace: Can't start or end with a space.
restoredVmNameError.nonAscii: Use Latin letters, numbers, and standard keyboard symbols only — no Cyrillic or other non-Latin characters.
restoredVmNameError.duplicate: A VM with this name already exists in the target environment. Choose another name.

mode.datastoreLowSpace: Only {{free}} free — the source VM is provisioned up to {{needed}}. The restore may run out of space if it doesn't fit thin.
mode.networkMapNone: This VM has no network adapters to map.
mode.networkMapHostNone: No virtual switches were discovered on the selected host. Pick another host, or rescan the inventory.
mode.networkMapEnvNone: No virtual switches were discovered in this environment. Rescan the inventory and try again.
mode.networkMapHint: Source networks come from the VM's own network adapters; the target list shows only the virtual switches on the selected host, and a same-named one is auto-selected — pick another from the list if needed.
mode.powerOnHint: Start the restored VM as soon as the restore completes.

bareMetal.subtitle: This is a full-server image — it comes back as one piece. You'll confirm before anything runs.

mode.title: Bare-metal recovery
mode.desc: Boots recovery media on the server, then restores every volume and the system state exactly as they were at this point.

bareMetal.lockedDest: A bare-metal image goes back to <1>{{name}}</1> — the original server, its original disks. Restoring it to different hardware isn't supported, so the destination is locked.
bareMetal.overwriteWarning: This restores in place and <1>overwrites everything on</1> <2>{{name}}</2> — every volume and the system state are replaced by this restore point. You'll confirm before anything runs.

files.title: Pick the files to recover
files.subtitle: Browse the backed-up folders from <1>{{name}}</1> and tick what you need. They download straight from the backup — nothing on the server changes.

disk.title: How would you like to recover this disk?
disk.subtitle: Put the disk back where it was, or export it as a file to attach elsewhere. You'll confirm before anything runs.

original.title: Restore in place
original.desc: Writes the disk back to its original device on {{name}}. Fast, but the disk's current contents are overwritten.

export.title: Export as a file
export.desc: Materialize the disk as a virtual-disk file you can attach to any machine — safe for inspection or side-by-side recovery.

disk.exportCallout: The disk is reconstructed into a <1>{{format}}</1> file on the appliance — nothing on {{owner}} is touched. Download it when it's ready.
disk.overwriteWarning: This overwrites <1>{{name}}</1> ({{device}}) on <2>{{owner}}</2> — the {{noun}}'s other disks are left alone, but this one's current contents are replaced. You'll confirm before anything runs.

error.title: Couldn't read this folder
error.desc: The backup may still be mounting — try again.

noMatch.title: Nothing matches that search
noMatch.desc: Try a different file or folder name.

conversion.title: Cross-platform conversion
conversion.subtitle: {{name}} runs a different hypervisor than this VM. AltaStor converts the disk and adapts the guest so it boots there.
conversion.noCaveats: No special caveats — the guest should boot on {{platform}} with its drivers adapted automatically.

instant.title: Instant restore

subtitle.discarded: "{{name}}" was discarded and the on-demand disk released.
subtitle.running: "{{name}}" is running directly off the backup.
subtitle.booting: Publishing the backup and powering "{{name}}" on…

instant.runningCallout: Blocks stream in on demand as the guest reads them; writes land in a scratch overlay, so the backup itself is never touched. Discard the VM when you're done to release the disk.
